definition: [ חוּג ] verb draw round, make a circle (Aramaic circumivit ; noun , חוּגְתָּא , circle, vault of heavens ) — Qal Perfect חֹק חָג עלפֿני מים Job 26:10 (compare Prov 8:27 ), hath drawn as a circle a bound, etc., of the horizon-line.
